skill.name: dont-touch-shutdown-guard
skill.description: Skill for the Roblox game DON'T TOUCH!: guards the emergency shutdown button. Arms a two-person confirmation rule, rate-limits activation attempts, logs every press to a DataStore audit trail, and exposes a safe test mode for CI.
skill.author: AliceLabs
skill.install: Rojo: place ShutdownGuard.luau in ServerScriptService/Skills/ (or paste into Studio)
